roadmap.title: Radiant route and fragile quests
roadmap.description: Use Legacy difficulty. Save Winterberry before taking Skinstealer’s lift. Speak to Drustan in the Gorge and Lower Calrath before opening the Fief, then light his Fief campfire. Finish Stomund’s banner hand-ins before entering The Empyrean and every Thehk-Ihir meeting before Judge Cleric. Give Sophesia the Swaddling Cloth before killing the Sundered Monarch. Finish Isaac’s summon quest; take hostile Kukajin and Damarose on this run. Buy merchant stock before departures, and obtain Damarose’s Laughter and spells before cleansing beacons. Complete Radiant and view Adyr’s memory.

roadmap.title: Inferno route and opposite NPC outcomes
roadmap.description: Restart Game +0 on the same character. Leave all beacons uncleansed. Complete Kukajin’s seven paid summons and Damarose’s successful quest. After buying Sophesia’s spells, withhold the Swaddling Cloth for her hostile boss. Complete the Inferno ending.

roadmap.title: Veteran Umbral route and collection purchases
roadmap.description: Restart Game +0 with Veteran selected. Preserve the Umbral route, finish Dunmire and the Iron Wayfarer, and defeat the Bringer Trio, Unbroken Promise, Engstrom and Elianne. Keep Gerlinde’s services through Sparky. Buy every remaining Molhu reward before his final dialogue. Finish missing enemy drops and collections before restarting.

roadmap.title: Dedicated modifier ending
roadmap.description: Restart Game +0 on Legacy with Ironman, Withered Health, Pre-upgraded Weapons, Random Loot, Random Enemies, Enemy Density and Tremendous Vestige Decay. Check the settings before starting. Carry Vestige Seeds and disable invasions. Complete a Radiant ending without full Umbral death to combine the eight modifier-ending achievements.

roadmap.title: Final Steam checklist
roadmap.description: Check the remaining Steam achievement list and finish any outstanding requirements.

achievements.description: Visited all of the areas in the game.
achievements.summary: Visit every area in Mournstead.

steps.text: Explore the main routes and side areas, including the @loc{Shrine of Adyr}, @loc{Path of Devotion} and @loc{Revelation Depths}.
After defeating Dervla and the Unbroken Promise, buy an @item{Umbral Scouring Clump} from Molhu for 50 Umbral Scourings. Use the clump at the well beyond their arena to enter @loc{Mother’s Lull}.
Check the area list if the achievement is still locked: [area-by-area route](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-collectible-guide/).

achievements.description: Died in Axiom for the first time.
achievements.summary: Lose all health in Axiom for the first time.

steps.text: Let an enemy defeat you in @mechanic{Axiom}; the transition into Umbral earns the achievement.

achievements.summary: Recover Vigor left behind after a full death.

guide.context: Another full death replaces the previous Vigor loss. Return before dying again.

steps.text: After dying in @mechanic{Umbral}, return to the Vigor marker and reclaim the dropped currency. If an enemy has purple eyes, defeat that enemy to recover the Vigor instead.

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game weapon and shield on one character.

steps.text: Keep your character through the three ending routes using @mechanic{Restart Game +0}. Buy weapons and shields from NPC shops before advancing their final quest steps.
Give Molhu the @item{Bowl of Revelations}. Soulflay boss memories and spend Umbral Scourings on their Remembrance weapons. Defeat Elianne on the Umbral route to access her sword.
Collect the rewards from both successful and hostile NPC routes on different runs. Buy @item{Elianne’s Sword} before Molhu leaves for Mother’s Lull.

Compare your inventory with [the weapon and shield list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-weapons-shields-locations/). Follow each missing item’s area link for its pickup, merchant or enemy drop.

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game armor piece, excluding online shrine sets, on one character.

steps.text: Buy NPC armor before its merchant leaves and collect quest reward sets across your ending runs. Keep using the same character.

Compare head, torso, arm and leg equipment with [the armor list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-armor-locations/). Collect missing world pickups and repeat the listed enemy encounters for random drops.
Use item-discovery equipment and paw consumables while farming. The @item{Veteran of the Veil} armor earned from a Veteran ending also raises item discovery.

achievements.summary: Acquire all 15 Umbral Eyes on one character.

steps.text: Save Winterberry through Byron’s quest: meet her in Revelation Depths and tell Byron about her before using the lift above Skinstealer. Ride the lift and open the door into Upper Calrath, then return to Skyrest and buy the @item{Umbral Eye of Ethryg} from Winterberry.
Stay in Umbral until the dread eye turns red and @enemy{Scarlet Shadow} appears. Defeat the enemy to receive @item{Umbral Eye of Marco the Axe}.
Soulflay the remaining eye-bearing Umbral Bellies. Compare your inventory with [the 15-eye location list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-umbral-eyes-locations/).

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game ring and pendant on one character.

steps.text: Buy rings and pendants from merchants before their final quest transitions, especially Winterberry, Stomund and Dunmire.
During Dunmire’s last journey, collect @item{Dunmire’s Ring} and @item{Dunmire’s Rosary} by the well into Mother’s Lull.

Use [the ring and pendant list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-rings-pendants-locations/) to identify missing pickups, merchant items and quest rewards. Keep the collection on your existing character between runs.

achievements.summary: Collect all ammunition types, including their enhanced variants.

guide.context: Ammunition cannot be received through item drops from another player.

steps.text: Buy ammunition from merchants and collect world pickups, including the enhanced variants. Compare the ammunition section of [the ammunition and throwable list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-ammo-types-throwables-locations/) with your inventory.

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game Inferno spell on one character.

guide.context: Spells cannot be traded between players. Keep your collection on one character across the ending runs.

steps.text: Before cleansing any beacon, buy Damarose’s spells, including @item{Adyr’s Endurance}. Buy the Tortured Prisoner’s new spells whenever her quest expands her shop.
Complete the Radiant ending, then return to the @loc{Shrine of Adyr}. Soulflay Adyr’s memory and purchase @item{Adyr’s Vengeance} and @item{Flame Funnel} from Molhu’s Remembrance inventory.

Collect the other Inferno pickups and boss spells using [the spell location list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-spell-locations/). Finish Molhu’s purchases before his final Umbral-ending dialogue.

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game Radiance spell on one character.

steps.text: Give Dunmire his evidence and buy each expansion of his spell inventory before handing over the @item{Perception Wisp}.
Buy Stomund’s spells before completing his banner hand-ins and entering The Empyrean. Purchase Radiance spells from boss Remembrances at Molhu.

Check [the spell location list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-spell-locations/) for the remaining Radiance pickups. Collect the spells on your existing character; spells cannot be traded.

achievements.summary: Collect every base-game Umbral spell on one character.

guide.context: Spell collections stay on one character; another player cannot drop spells for you.

steps.text: Give Molhu the @item{Bowl of Revelations}. Buy his Umbral spells and the Umbral spells in boss Remembrances as they become available.

Search Forsaken Fen for @item{Putrefaction}, the Fief for @item{Pestilent Blade} and @item{Misery Missile}, Path of Devotion for @item{Diminishing Missile}, and the Abbey for @item{Lacerating Weapon}.

Compare your spells with [the spell location list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-spell-locations/). Buy everything still needed from Molhu before asking him to enter Mother’s Lull.

achievements.summary: Collect every throwable type, including the enhanced versions.

guide.context: Throwables cannot be transferred from another player.

steps.text: Collect throwable pickups and buy missing types from merchants, including their enhanced versions. Compare the throwable section of [the ammunition and throwable list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-ammo-types-throwables-locations/) with your inventory.

achievements.summary: Learn all 21 original gestures on one character.

steps.text: Connect online and visit the shrines of Orius and the Putrid Mother in Skyrest, plus the Shrine of Adyr in Fitzroy’s Gorge, for their three gestures.
Exhaust Dunmire, Thehk-Ihir, Drustan and the rescued Tortured Prisoner’s dialogue. Speak to Byron at Catrin for @item{Bemoaning}; save Winterberry for @item{Celebration}.
Defeat Crimson Rector Percival and speak to Damarose at the Shrine of Adyr for @item{Laughter}, before cleansing a beacon or killing her.
During the Umbral route, talk to the Iron Wayfarer in the Fief for @item{Surrender} before using the Withered Rune on him.

Check [the gesture list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-gesture-locations/) for the starting gestures and remaining world pickups, including Common Orian Prayer, Pledge to Adyr, Halting and Hallowed Sentinel Prayer.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Sanguinarix to its maximum level.

steps.text: Collect @item{Saintly Quintessences} from Umbral Bellies and bring them to @npc{Pieta} at Skyrest. The full upgrade costs 20 quintessences.

Find missing quintessences using [the upgrade location list](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-sanguinarix-upgrades-locations/). Finish Pieta’s upgrades before choosing Soulflay during the Umbral route.

achievements.summary: Raise a weapon to its maximum upgrade level.

guide.context: Finish before using Gerlinde’s Seedpod, or give the final Rune Tablet to Sparky first so that Vestige upgrade services remain available.

steps.text: Take the @item{Prison Cell Key} from the guard by Gerlinde’s Pilgrim’s Perch cell and free her. Meet her at Skyrest.
Use her upgrade service to bring a weapon to @item{+10}, supplying Deralium for each level and a @item{Deralium Chunk} for the last upgrade.

achievements.description: Placed a rune in a socket for the first time.
achievements.summary: Insert a rune into a weapon or shield socket.

steps.text: Find the @item{Cracked Rune Tablet} in the Fitzroy’s Gorge cave near Drustan and give it to Gerlinde. Use her rune service to place a compatible rune in an unlocked socket.

achievements.description: Fully socketed a 3-rune weapon or shield.
achievements.summary: Fill every socket of a weapon or shield with three rune slots.

steps.text: Give Gerlinde the @item{Cracked Rune Tablet} from Fitzroy’s Gorge and the @item{Chipped Rune Tablet} from the Calrath fireplace on the way to Sunless Skein.
Collect the final @item{Rune Tablet} from the lower Tower of Penance chest. Give it to Sparky if you also want Travels Resumed, or to Gerlinde.
Upgrade equipment that supports three rune sockets until all sockets open. Insert a compatible rune in each socket using Gerlinde’s service or the Vestige service unlocked by freeing Sparky.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Umbral Lamp to its maximum level.

steps.text: Find the three @item{Antediluvian Chisels} in Lower Calrath, the Fief and the Manse. Use [the area route](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-collectible-guide/) to locate their containers.
Take each chisel to @npc{Molhu} in Umbral Skyrest and purchase all three lamp upgrades.

achievements.description: Fully socketed the Umbral lamp with Umbral Eyes.
achievements.summary: Fill all three Umbral Lamp eye sockets.

steps.text: Fully upgrade the lamp at Molhu. Use his eye-socketing service to equip one Umbral Eye in the main socket and two more in the secondary sockets.

achievements.summary: Bring a human co-op partner into your world.

steps.text: At a Vestige, open @mechanic{Multiplayer} and choose @mechanic{Beckon Lampbearer} or @mechanic{Beckon Friend}. Wait for the player to join.

achievements.description: Defeated a boss alongside a co-op partner.
achievements.summary: Win a boss fight with a human co-op partner.

steps.text: Beckon another player at a Vestige, enter a boss arena together and defeat the boss.

achievements.summary: Kill the enemy marked by a fallen lampbearer’s revenge lamp.

steps.text: Soulflay a red lamp left by another player. Follow the red butterflies and defeat their marked enemy. If the trail ends at an empty spot, check that location in Umbral.

achievements.summary: Kill another player in PvP.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Slaughter Lampbearer} from a Vestige’s Multiplayer menu and defeat a player in the invaded world. Defeating a player who invades you also counts.

achievements.description: Donated a total of 10 Severed Hands.
achievements.summary: Give the Shrine of Adyr a total of 10 Severed Hands.

steps.text: Earn at least 10 @item{Severed Hands} by defeating other players in PvP.
Take the Umbral side path from the Ruiner bridge in Fitzroy’s Gorge to the @loc{Shrine of Adyr}. Use the shrine’s donation option while connected online and offer 10 hands.

achievements.description: Donated a total of 10 Pilfered Coins.
achievements.summary: Give the Shrine of Orius a total of 10 Pilfered Coins.

steps.text: Join another player through @mechanic{Accompany Lampbearer} and help defeat bosses until you have 10 @item{Pilfered Coins}.
At Skyrest’s @loc{Shrine of Orius}, use the donation option while online and offer 10 coins.

achievements.description: Donated a total of 10 Plucked Eyeballs.
achievements.summary: Give the Shrine of the Putrid Mother a total of 10 Plucked Eyeballs.

steps.text: Soulflay red revenge lamps and kill their marked enemies until you have 10 @item{Plucked Eyeballs}.
Enter Umbral at Skyrest and visit the @loc{Shrine of the Putrid Mother} near Molhu. Use its donation option while online and offer 10 eyeballs.

achievements.description: Applied a tinct to a piece of gear.
achievements.summary: Use a tinct to recolor a piece of equipment.

steps.text: Open the equipment menu’s @mechanic{Tincts} tab and apply an owned tinct to an armor piece.

achievements.description: Defeat Pieta, She of Blessed Renewal.
achievements.summary: Defeat Pieta, She of Blessed Renewal.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Pieta, She of Blessed Renewal} at @loc{Abandoned Redcopse, before Skyrest Bridge} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Congregator of Flesh.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{The Congregator of Flesh} at @loc{Forsaken Fen} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Hushed Saint.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{The Hushed Saint} at @loc{Forsaken Fen, at the beacon} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat Spurned Progeny.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Spurned Progeny} at @loc{Lower Calrath} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Unbroken Promise.

steps.text: Defeat Skinstealer and use the @item{Drainage Control Key} to lower the Cistern water. Descend into @loc{Revelation Depths}.
At the bottom, defeat @enemy{Harrower Dervla} and then her second phase, @enemy{The Unbroken Promise}.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Hollow Crow.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{The Hollow Crow} at @loc{Fief of the Chill Curse} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat Reinhold the Immured.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Reinhold the Immured} at @loc{Tower of Penance, after Tancred} and win.

achievements.description: Defeat Judge Cleric, the Radiant Sentinel.
achievements.summary: Defeat Judge Cleric, the Radiant Sentinel.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Judge Cleric, the Radiant Sentinel} at @loc{The Empyrean} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Lightreaper.

guide.context: Killing the Lightreaper at an earlier encounter removes the Upper Calrath fight and its quest summons for this run.

steps.text: Fight the @enemy{Lightreaper} at his final arena in @loc{Upper Calrath}. If completing Isaac’s or Kukajin’s quest, summon that NPC for this victory.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Sundered Monarch.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{The Sundered Monarch} at @loc{Bramis Castle throne room} and win.

achievements.summary: Defeat Elianne the Starved.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon or opening Bramis Castle with the ordinary Rune of Adyr closes this route for the current run.

steps.text: Follow @mechanic{Back to the Void} through opening Bramis Castle with the Withered Rune and defeating the Sundered Monarch.
Use @item{Melchior’s Seedpod} at Adyr’s effigy. Approach Harkyn in Umbral Fief and use @item{Withered Rune of Adyr}. Take his parasite.
Place the Lightreaper’s and Harkyn’s parasites in Molhu’s pillars. Speak to Molhu and rest.
Choose @mechanic{Soulflay} when speaking to Pieta. Defeat @enemy{Elianne the Starved} in the resulting arena.

achievements.summary: Defeat Adyr, the Bereft Exile.

steps.text: Cleanse the five beacons and defeat the Sundered Monarch. Speak to @npc{Adyr’s effigy} above the throne room to enter the final fight and defeat Adyr.

achievements.description: Defeat every required boss on one character.
achievements.summary: Defeat every original main and optional boss on one character.

guide.context: Boss credit accumulates on the same character. The hostile NPC routes and their successful quests require different playthroughs.

steps.text: Defeat the main and optional bosses in [the boss registry](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-all-boss-locations/) across your runs. Include @enemy{Paladin’s Burden} and @enemy{Andreas of Ebb}, plus Adyr on the Radiant route and Elianne on the Umbral route.
For hostile Damarose, cleanse a beacon and defeat her at the burning building on the Bramis Castle approach.
For hostile Kukajin, summon her for a required boss, leave her invoice unpaid and defeat another boss. Fight her on the Upper Calrath shortcut route.
For hostile Tortured Prisoner, move her quest to Bramis Castle but withhold the @item{Swaddling Cloth}. Kill the Sundered Monarch, then fight her near the royal bedroom.

achievements.description: Finish Exacter Dunmire’s search for knowledge.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Finish Exacter Dunmire’s search for knowledge.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Bloody Aspergillum} beside Scourged Sister Delyth. Deliver it to @npc{Dunmire} at Skyrest.
steps.note: After each delivery, exhaust Dunmire’s dialogue. Rest at a Vestige if the next hand-in is unavailable.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Book of Sin} from a Pilgrim’s Perch Umbral Belly and give it to Dunmire.
Collect the @item{Hallowed Sentinel Scripture} on Pilgrim’s Perch’s high platform and give it to Dunmire.
Collect @item{Vanguard Barros’ Rosary} from the Forsaken Fen hut beyond Mendacious Visage and deliver it to Dunmire. Then bring him @item{Ravager Gregory’s Rosary} from the Lower Calrath roof.
Defeat Dervla for the @item{Dark Crusader’s Call}. Give Dunmire the Call, rest, then give him the @item{Umbral Tome} from the tower leading to Sunless Skein.
Buy his remaining stock. Soulflay the Tower of Penance cell stigma for the @item{Perception Wisp} and give him the Wisp.
Speak to him at the Sunless Skein poison pool and then in Mother’s Lull. Return to the tunnel toward Upper Calrath near @loc{Hooded Antuli} and collect his abandoned equipment.

achievements.description: Complete Damarose the Marked’s successful quest.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Complete Damarose the Marked’s successful quest.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon or using Damarose’s Seedpod ends this successful quest route.

steps.text: Leave every beacon uncleansed. Speak to Damarose before Delyth, before Gentle Gaverus, in Fitzroy’s Gorge and at the Shrine of Adyr.
Bring her the @item{Adyr-Worshipper’s Saw} from Cistern, then the flesh dropped by @enemy{Infernal Enchantress}, @enemy{Spurned Progeny} and @enemy{Lightreaper}.
Meet her at Bramis Castle and buy any missing stock. After defeating the Sundered Monarch, collect her gear near Adyr’s effigy.

achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Free Sparky from Gerlinde.

guide.context: Giving the final tablet to Gerlinde loses this achievement for the run. Sparky’s freedom enables upgrades and rune work at Vestiges.

steps.text: Rescue Gerlinde and Sparky from the Pilgrim’s Perch cell. Give Gerlinde the Cracked and Chipped Rune Tablets from Fitzroy’s Gorge and Calrath.
Collect the final @item{Rune Tablet} from the lower Tower of Penance chest and give this tablet to @npc{Sparky}.

achievements.description: Resolve Byron’s search without killing Winterberry.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Resolve Byron’s search without killing Winterberry.

guide.context: Taking Skinstealer’s lift before informing Byron about Winterberry kills her and ends this route for the run.

steps.text: Talk to Byron at Bellroom, Forsaken Fen and the @loc{Catrin Vestige}. After killing Skinstealer, leave the lift above his arena unused.
Use the Drainage Control Key to lower the water and descend to @loc{Revelation Depths}. Speak to @npc{Winterberry} and leave her alive.
Return to Byron at Catrin and tell him about Winterberry. Ride Skinstealer’s lift and open the door into Upper Calrath. Return to Skyrest and speak to Byron and Winterberry.

achievements.description: Complete Drustan’s journey in search of his brother.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Complete Drustan’s journey in search of his brother.

guide.context: Opening the Fief too early or leaving Drustan’s fire unlit loses his successful route for this run.

steps.text: Speak to Drustan in Fitzroy’s Gorge and on the Lower Calrath Alehouse balcony. Give him @item{Unripe Berries} before opening the Fief gate.
Find him beyond the Fief’s ice cave, light his campfire and exhaust his dialogue.
In Bramis Castle, soulflay Drustan’s memory in the ruined tower and collect his gear. Also view Melchior’s memory by the Sundered Monarch if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.description: Defeat Andreas of Ebb at the end of his quest.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Defeat Andreas of Ebb at the end of his quest.

steps.text: After Spurned Progeny, speak to Andreas at Skyrest. Pass his ice-tunnel ambush in the Fief, then speak to him again at Skyrest.
Soulflay the memory on the shortcut between Pieta’s arena and Upper Calrath to get @item{Andreas of Ebb's Book of Lineage}. Deliver the recovered book to Andreas.
Defeat the Lightreaper in Upper Calrath. Follow the path out of the arena and defeat Andreas when he attacks.

achievements.description: Finish Stomund’s quest and recover his remains in The Empyrean.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Finish Stomund’s quest and recover his remains in The Empyrean.

guide.context: Opening the Empyrean approach doors before the banner hand-ins ends Stomund’s quest for this run.

steps.text: Meet Stomund at the Manse and then the Abbey. For the @item{Damaged Standard}, take the Manse lift under the stairs leading to the Abiding Defenders and search the side path.
For the @item{Tattered Banner}, take the Abbey large hall’s stairs to the upper side balcony and defeat the Abbess there.
Give both banners to Stomund. Buy his remaining spells and equipment before opening the large doors toward The Empyrean by @loc{Iorelo’s Vestige}.
Enter The Empyrean and collect Stomund’s impaled remains to the right of the stairs.

achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Finish Thehk-Ihir’s journey through Mournstead.

guide.context: Finish every meeting before Judge Cleric dies; her defeat ends Thehk-Ihir’s merchant route.

steps.text: Exhaust Thehk-Ihir’s dialogue at Pilgrim’s Perch, Forsaken Fen’s Pale Butcher Vestige and Skyrest.
Continue his meetings at the Fief’s Loash Vestige, Path of Devotion’s Dieter Vestige, the Manse’s Brother Jeremiah Vestige and the Abbey’s Rosamund Vestige. Finish shopping at the Abbey.
Defeat Judge Cleric and collect the @item{Thorned Chalice} in her arena.

achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Complete Sophesia’s successful quest.

guide.context: Defeating the Monarch without giving her the Swaddling Cloth turns Sophesia hostile and loses this successful quest route.

steps.text: Explore the lower Skyrest bridge route for the @item{Skyrest Bridge Key} and open the crypt/prison access. In Umbral, remove the three bridge Soulflay targets and climb to @item{Searing Accusation}; give the catalyst to the Tortured Prisoner.
Meet her outside by Pieta’s arena. Defeat Spurned Progeny, give her its @item{Giant Eyeball} and find the @item{Noblewoman Set} in Upper Calrath.
Wear the Noblewoman Set when speaking to her at the Progeny arena. Later speak to her at the Upper Calrath beacon for @item{Elegant Perfume}.
Find the @item{Charred Letter} near Bramis Castle’s entrance stairs and give it to her. Meet her by the @loc{Bloody Pilgrim Vestige}.
Bring her the @item{Swaddling Cloth} from the royal bedroom before defeating the Sundered Monarch. After the boss, speak to her in the throne room.

achievements.description: Bring the Iron Wayfarer’s Umbral quest to its conclusion.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Bring the Iron Wayfarer’s Umbral quest to its conclusion.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon or using the ordinary Rune at the Bramis gate closes the Umbral route for this run.

steps.text: On the Umbral route, exhaust the Iron Wayfarer’s Redcopse dialogue. Enter Umbral in Forsaken Fen and speak to him by the flowerbed. Meet him again in Lower Calrath.
In Upper Calrath, speak to him in the long tunnel and soulflay his memory. Rest, then meet him beyond the gate by the ladder and view his next memory. Speak to him on the Manse route near Ferrers.

Let him assist against the Rapturous Huntress and take the Rune of Adyr. Defeat him outside Bramis Castle to recover the Rune; exchange it at Mother’s Lull for the @item{Withered Rune of Adyr} before opening the gate.
Defeat the Sundered Monarch and use @item{Melchior’s Seedpod} at Adyr’s effigy. Enter Umbral in the Fief and find the Wayfarer beyond the Svornil wall-and-ladder route.
Speak to him for the @item{Surrender} gesture, then use the Withered Rune on him. Collect @item{Harkyn’s Umbral Parasite} and his equipment.

achievements.description: Defeat the Upper Calrath Lightreaper with Paladin Isaac summoned.
achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Defeat the Upper Calrath Lightreaper with Paladin Isaac summoned.

guide.context: An earlier Lightreaper kill loses this quest. Kukajin needs the same summon slot for her quest, so complete her route on another run.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Flayed Skin} at the right fork beyond the tutorial boss arena.
Soulflay Isaac’s memories by the Wooden Dark Crusader Cross in Fitzroy’s Gorge, near Svornil in the Fief, beyond the Fief Lightreaper arena and on Path of Devotion near Dieter.
In Umbral, follow Path of Devotion past the opened barrier. Soulflay the next memory and defeat @enemy{Paladin’s Burden}.
Return to the tutorial right-fork Umbral door. Use the @item{Umbral-Tinged Flayed Skin} and collect Isaac’s equipment.
At the Upper Calrath Lightreaper arena, make a failed attempt if Isaac’s sign is absent. Summon @npc{Paladin Isaac} and defeat the Lightreaper.

achievements.summary: Reach the Inferno ending.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon or committing to the Withered Rune route removes this ending from the current run.

steps.text: Leave every beacon uncleansed. In the Abbey, obtain the @item{Rune of Adyr}. Enter Bramis Castle and defeat the Sundered Monarch.
Speak to Adyr’s effigy for the @item{Empowered Rune of Adyr}. Use the empowered rune at the beacons in Forsaken Fen, the Fief, Tower of Penance and Upper Calrath, finishing at The Empyrean.
After empowering the Empyrean beacon, use the rune on the kneeling Judge Cleric. Speak to @npc{Iselle} inside her mind.

achievements.summary: Reach the Radiant ending.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon closes the Inferno and Umbral routes for this run.

steps.text: Cleanse the beacons in Forsaken Fen, the Fief, Tower of Penance, Upper Calrath and The Empyrean.
Defeat the Sundered Monarch, speak to Adyr’s effigy above the throne room and defeat Adyr. Enter the ending circle.

achievements.summary: Reach the Umbral ending.

guide.context: Cleansing any beacon or opening Bramis Castle with the ordinary Rune of Adyr loses this ending for the current run.

steps.text: Keep every beacon uncleansed. Rescue Gerlinde and move Damarose to the Shrine of Adyr. Follow the Iron Wayfarer meeting sequence in @mechanic{The Last Step}. Finish equipment upgrades and free Sparky before killing Gerlinde.
Defeat Dervla and the Unbroken Promise. Buy an @item{Umbral Scouring Clump} from Molhu for 50 scourings and use it at the well beyond their arena.
Take @item{Damarose’s Seedpod} from the Mother’s Lull remnant and use it on Damarose. Return for @item{Gerlinde’s Seedpod} and use that on Gerlinde.
Defeat the Lightreaper and place his parasite in Molhu’s pillar. Let the Iron Wayfarer take the Rune at the Rapturous Huntress fight; recover it by defeating him outside Bramis Castle.
Before opening the Bramis gate, exchange the Rune with the Mother’s Lull remnant for the @item{Withered Rune of Adyr} and @item{Melchior’s Seedpod}. Open the gate with the Withered Rune.
Defeat the Sundered Monarch and use Melchior’s Seedpod at Adyr’s effigy. Find Harkyn in Umbral at the Fief, obtain Surrender through dialogue, then use the Withered Rune on him.
Place Harkyn’s parasite at Molhu’s pillar, speak to Molhu and rest. Choose @mechanic{Soulflay} in Pieta’s dialogue and defeat Elianne. Soulflay her memory and buy her Remembrance equipment.
Finish every remaining Molhu purchase, place Elianne’s parasite and choose @mechanic{Enter Mother’s Lull} with Molhu. Soulflay the anchors to move across the platforms and reach the final figure.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Scarlet Shadow.

guide.context: The Scarlet Shadow disables Sanguinarix use while present. The old ladder exploit does not provide a safe kill.

steps.text: Prepare upgraded equipment, then remain in Umbral until the dread eye turns red. Defeat the @enemy{Scarlet Shadow} that begins hunting you.

achievements.description: Defeated an enemy with an Umbral finisher.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an Umbral finisher.

guide.context: Avoid poison or other damage over time during the attempt; those effects can kill the target before the finisher.

steps.text: Soulflay an enemy and strike the exposed soul until the enemy’s entire health bar is white with wither damage.
Move to the body when its red finisher marker appears and use the melee grievous strike.

achievements.summary: Plant a Vestige Seed in an Umbral flowerbed.

steps.text: Use a @item{Vestige Seed} at an @mechanic{Umbral flowerbed} to create a checkpoint. The Iron Wayfarer gives seeds before Pieta, and Molhu sells more.

achievements.estTime: 1 hour of additional leveling if needed
achievements.summary: Raise one character to level 100.

steps.text: Spend Vigor through @mechanic{Upgrade Character} at Vestiges until the character’s level reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Earn the game’s complete achievement set.

steps.text: Complete the remaining achievement requirements in your Steam list.

achievements.description: Offered Molhu the Bowl of Revelations.
achievements.summary: Give the Bowl of Revelations to Molhu.

steps.text: From Pilgrim’s Perch Bellroom, follow the lower ladder route in Umbral. Soulflay the Belly among the cocoons for the @item{Bowl of Revelations}.
Bring the Bowl to @npc{Molhu} in Umbral Skyrest and hand it over to unlock Remembrance trading.

achievements.summary: View all Umbral stigmas on one character.

guide.context: Use the same character across the ending runs; quest failures can remove their later memories from that run.

steps.text: Enter Umbral wherever blue moths mark a memory. Soulflay the memory figure and let the scene play.

Follow [the area-ordered Stigmas checklist](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3066748619) while preserving Isaac’s, Drustan’s and the Iron Wayfarer’s quests. Their scenes add memories beyond ordinary exploration.
After the Radiant ending, view Adyr’s memory at the Shrine of Adyr. On the Umbral route, view Elianne’s memory after defeating her, before leaving the arena.

For missing memories, revisit the Lightreaper arenas in Redcopse, Fitzroy’s Gorge, the Fief and Upper Calrath. Use [the area route](https://www.powerpyx.com/lords-of-the-fallen-2023-collectible-guide/) for remaining scene locations.

achievements.summary: Enter the Skyrest Bridge interior.

steps.text: After defeating Pieta, descend the tower stairs into @loc{Skyrest Bridge} and watch the arrival scene.

achievements.estTime: 30 min of quest actions across the run
achievements.summary: Complete Kukajin’s paid boss-assistance quest.

guide.context: Skipping a required summon or leaving an invoice unpaid while advancing bosses loses this route. Isaac’s Lightreaper quest needs a separate run.

steps.text: Find petrified Kukajin in the Forsaken Fen cave. Use @item{Sanctify} to restore her without attacking, then speak to her at Skyrest.
Summon her for the Hushed Saint, Dervla and the Unbroken Promise, Hollow Crow, Tancred and Reinhold, Judge Cleric, the Upper Calrath Lightreaper and Sundered Monarch.
If a summon sign is missing, make a failed boss attempt first. After every victory, return to Skyrest and pay Kukajin before defeating another boss.
After the last payment, exhaust her dialogue, rest and collect the gear she leaves.

achievements.description: Reached an ending with the Pre-upgraded Weapons and Random Loot modifiers enabled.
achievements.summary: Reach any ending with Pre-upgraded Weapons and Random Loot enabled.

steps.text: At the start of a New Game or @mechanic{Restart Game +0}, enable @mechanic{Pre-upgraded Weapons and Random Loot}. Check the selected modifiers before confirming.
Complete an ending with those settings. The Radiant route is suitable for a dedicated modifier run.

achievements.description: Reached an ending with the Ironman and Withered Health modifiers enabled.
achievements.summary: Reach any ending with Ironman and Withered Health enabled.

guide.context: Healing creates white withered health. Deal damage to turn that portion back into usable health.

steps.text: At the start of a New Game or @mechanic{Restart Game +0}, enable @mechanic{Ironman and Withered Health}. Check the selected modifiers before confirming.
Reach an ending without a full death in Umbral. If Ironman resets the world, complete the replacement run with the required modifiers still selected.

achievements.description: Started a new game with a modifier enabled.
achievements.summary: Begin a playthrough with at least one gameplay modifier active.

steps.text: Choose a modifier when starting New Game or @mechanic{Restart Game +0}, then begin the run with that selection.

achievements.description: Defeat Elianne the Starved in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat Elianne the Starved in Veteran Mode.

guide.context: Cleansing a beacon or opening Bramis Castle with the ordinary Rune loses access to Elianne for that run.

steps.text: Start or restart a run with @mechanic{Veteran} selected. Follow the full Umbral ending route, keeping beacons uncleansed and using the Withered Rune at Bramis.
After placing the Lightreaper and Harkyn parasites and speaking to Molhu, rest and choose @mechanic{Soulflay} in Pieta’s dialogue. Defeat Elianne.

achievements.description: Defeat The Unbroken Promise in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Unbroken Promise in Veteran Mode.

steps.text: In a @mechanic{Veteran} run, defeat Skinstealer and use the Drainage Control Key to lower the Cistern water. Descend into Revelation Depths.
Defeat Dervla at the bottom, then defeat her second phase, @enemy{The Unbroken Promise}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Cistern’s Bringer Trio in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Cistern’s Bringer Trio in Veteran Mode.

steps.text: In a @mechanic{Veteran} run, enter Umbral in the Cistern and follow the side platforms to the Bringer arena.
Defeat @enemy{Bringer of Stillness}, then the @enemy{Bringer of Silence} and @enemy{Bringer of Nullity} that join the fight.

achievements.description: Defeat General Engstrom in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Defeat General Engstrom in Veteran Mode.

guide.context: Crimson Ritual Fervour comes from the online Shrine of Adyr. All five burning hands must be extinguished before the summon gesture works.

steps.text: In a @mechanic{Veteran} run, use @item{Pledge to Adyr} at the tree in the Fitzroy’s Gorge Lightreaper arena. The gesture is on a broken catapult in Calrath.
Collect @item{Wintry Ordnance} on the Fief route beyond Svornil. Throw snowballs at the five burning hands listed below.
Fief: check the tree on Harkyn’s wall-and-ladder route from Svornil. Gorge: approach from Pale Butcher and look behind the hill with the crossbow enemy.

Upper Calrath: search the tree in the square on the Skyrest shortcut. For the Sunless Skein hand, collect the @item{Sunless Skein Key} from the cages in the last room before Cistern. Use the key at the door near Hooded Antuli, follow the rails to the lava forges and climb two ladders to the tower.

Bramis Castle: obtain the @item{Royal Key}. From the castle’s main entrance, head left to the burning stairs and enter Umbral to pass them. Open the royal dining-room door and reach the back garden. Extinguish its hand.
Return to the starting tree and perform @item{Crimson Ritual Fervour}. Defeat @enemy{General Engstrom}.

achievements.description: Reach any ending in Veteran Mode.
achievements.summary: Reach any ending in Veteran Mode.

guide.context: For co-op, both players must use the same difficulty mode.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Veteran} when starting or restarting the run. You can carry your existing character into Veteran through @mechanic{Restart Game +0}.
Complete the Umbral route to combine this ending with Veteran Elianne. Defeat the Veteran Bringer Trio, Unbroken Promise and General Engstrom during that run.
